delete_events.description: If true, queue deletion of all events associated with these persons.

delete_recordings.description: If true, queue deletion of all recordings associated with these persons.

distinct_ids.description: A list of distinct IDs whose associated persons will be deleted (max 1000).

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is deleted and `persons_found` reports how many persons the request would delete in total. Use this to confirm the scope of a filter before running it.

ids.description: A list of PostHog person UUIDs to delete (max 1000).

keep_person.description: If true, keep the person records but delete their events and recordings.

properties.description: Person property filters describing which persons to delete, in the same format as the `properties` parameter of the persons list endpoint. Deletes one page of up to 1000 matching persons per call, so repeat the same request while `has_more` is true to delete the rest.

key.description: The person property to filter on, or the cohort ID when `type` is `cohort`.

operator.description: Comparison operator, for example `exact`, `icontains`, `gt`, `is_set`. Defaults to `exact`.

type.description: Either `person` (filter on a person property) or `cohort`. Defaults to `person`.

value.description: The value to compare against. A list for operators like `exact` with multiple options.

search.description: Restrict the persons to delete to those matching this search term. Can be combined with `properties`.
